# TinySoundFont

Unmodified `tsf.h` and MIT LICENSE from Bernhard Schelling's TinySoundFont,
revision `853a0a171759f1ddba0de1442133a75912bbeffa`:
https://github.com/schellingb/TinySoundFont

The app's MIDI scheduler and bounded SF2 validation are in
`app/src/main/cpp/midi_decoder.cpp`. No example SoundFonts or game samples from
upstream are bundled. Pixel GM is generated from original waveforms by
`scripts/generate-soundfont.py` under the application's MIT license.
